ingredients.name: Fire
ingredients.description: Primal combustion dancing with restless caloric vigor, capable of calcining matter and awakening dormant ores.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.description: Distilled spring aqua prized by alchemists as the universal cradle of dissolution, hydration, and life.

ingredients.name: Earth
ingredients.description: Rich mineral-bearing terra heavy with ancient silicates, dormant spores, and metallic veins.

ingredients.name: Air
ingredients.description: Swirling atmospheric breath that fans embers into roaring furnaces and lifts vapors toward the heavens.

ingredients.name: Steam
ingredients.description: Superheated scalding vapor born from the union of flame and water, driving condensers and extraction coils.

ingredients.name: Heat
ingredients.description: Concentrated thermal energy radiating invisible waves strong enough to liquefy metals and vitrify sand.

ingredients.name: Ice
ingredients.description: Glacial hexagonal water crystal locked in rigid stillness, arresting volatile reactions on contact.

ingredients.name: Electricity
ingredients.description: Crackling storm-born fulgurite charge that splits molecules and awakens galvanic currents in solutions.

ingredients.name: Mud
ingredients.description: Slick alluvial mire teeming with dissolved minerals and primed for both ceramic shaping and botanical growth.

ingredients.name: Stone
ingredients.description: Dense granite-basalt aggregate forged under crust pressure, serving as foundation rock and raw ore host.

ingredients.name: Lava
ingredients.description: Molten subterranean rock veined with blinding orange fissures that cools into volcanic stone and glass.

ingredients.name: Sand
ingredients.description: Fine golden silica grains eroded from ancient stone, essential for blowing clear laboratory glassware.

ingredients.name: Clay
ingredients.description: Smooth terracotta kaolin paste that holds intricate impressions and fires into heatproof vessels.

ingredients.name: Brimstone Sulfur
ingredients.description: Bright canary-yellow volcanic crystal representing the fiery Soul in Paracelsian Tria Prima theory.

ingredients.name: Alchemical Salt
ingredients.description: Cubic halite crystals symbolizing the fixed physical Body in the alchemical triad of transmutation.

ingredients.name: Clear Quartz
ingredients.description: Six-sided hexagonal rock crystal that focuses luminous beams and vibrates under electrical charge.

ingredients.name: Obsidian
ingredients.description: Jet-black volcanic glass quenched in sudden frost, gleaming with violet conchoidal fractures.

ingredients.name: Verdant Moss
ingredients.description: Velvety emerald bryophyte cushion that awakens the first spark of botanical life from damp stone.

ingredients.name: Silverleaf Herb
ingredients.description: Serrated apothecary foliage shimmering with silvery essential oils used as the base of herbal tinctures.

ingredients.name: Sunpetal Blossom
ingredients.description: Golden heliotropic bloom whose petals retain concentrated daylight warmth even at midnight.

ingredients.name: Frostbloom Lily
ingredients.description: Translucent ice-blue alpine flower that exhales freezing mist and never withers in winter.

ingredients.name: Lumen Mycelium
ingredients.description: Clustered subterranean fungi whose gills pulse with eerie cyan bioluminescence and reactive spores.

ingredients.name: Shadow Nightshade
ingredients.description: Glossy dark-purple belladonna berries steeped in potent alkaloids and nocturnal essence.

ingredients.name: Mandragora Root
ingredients.description: Gnarled rootstock crowned with vibrant leaves, prized in high alchemy for binding life-force to elixirs.

ingredients.name: Golden Amber Sap
ingredients.description: Fossilized golden botanical resin famous since antiquity for trapping light and static charge.

ingredients.name: Crude Metal
ingredients.description: Smelted metallic bloom liberated from stone by fierce flame, ready to be refined into noble and base metals.

ingredients.name: Molten Metal
ingredients.description: Blinding orange-white liquid metal swirling inside a refractory crucible, eager to fuse into new alloys.

ingredients.name: Forged Iron
ingredients.description: Sturdy dark-grey martial metal ruled by Mars, exhibiting strong magnetism and structural resilience.

ingredients.name: Red Copper
ingredients.description: Lustrous salmon-red metal of Venus fashioned into alembic stills, lightning rods, and galvanic coils.

ingredients.name: Lunar Silver
ingredients.description: Mirror-pure noble metal attuned to Luna, resisting corrosion and channeling subtle astral reflections.

ingredients.name: Saturnine Lead
ingredients.description: Ponderous slate-dark metal of Saturn, traditionally chosen as the humble base matter for chrysopoeia.

ingredients.name: Quicksilver
ingredients.description: Living liquid mercury representing the volatile Spirit in the Tria Prima, dissolving metals on touch.

ingredients.name: Alchemical Bronze
ingredients.description: Sonorous golden-brown alloy cast into precision astrolabes, pressure valves, and clockwork gears.

ingredients.name: Solar Gold
ingredients.description: Tarnishless royal metal of Sol, sought for millennia as perfection in metallic nature.

ingredients.name: Thermal Shock
ingredients.description: Violent stress-wave unleashed when extreme frost collides with roaring flame, shattering rigid lattices.

ingredients.name: Charged Water
ingredients.description: Luminous electrolyzed aqua surging with dissolved ions and miniature submerged lightning arcs.

ingredients.name: Alchemical Glass
ingredients.description: Crystal-clear borosilicate glass blown into retorts and flasks impervious to boiling acids.

ingredients.name: Refractory Porcelain
ingredients.description: High-fired white ceramic crucible ware engineered to withstand white-hot plasma and corrosive salts.

ingredients.name: Calcined Ash
ingredients.description: Fine pale potash powder left after organic matter undergoes complete alchemical calcination.

ingredients.name: Vitriol Acid
ingredients.description: Fuming emerald Oil of Vitriol distilled from sulfur vapors, biting fiercely into base metals and stone.

ingredients.name: Black Powder
ingredients.description: Volatile ternary mixture of brimstone, salt, and calcined ash that erupts in thunderous scarlet fire.

ingredients.name: Mercuric Amalgam
ingredients.description: Silvery-gold metallic paste formed when quicksilver embraces solid metal in cold dissolution.

ingredients.name: Aqua Regia
ingredients.description: Smoking amber-crimson Royal Water - the fabled synthetic acid potent enough to dissolve pure Solar Gold.

ingredients.name: Luminous Aether
ingredients.description: Iridescent fifth element shimmering between light and vapor, bridging terrestrial matter with celestial law.

ingredients.name: Contained Plasma
ingredients.description: Magnetically suspended miniature star-core pulsing with violet-white arcs of fourth-state matter.

ingredients.name: Absolute Zero Shard
ingredients.description: Hyper-ordered sapphire lattice chilled near total stillness, freezing ambient vapor into diamond dust.

ingredients.name: Phoenix Cinder
ingredients.description: Plume-shaped ruby ember that rekindles from its own ashes, radiating inexhaustible solar vitality.

ingredients.name: Abyssal Nigredo
ingredients.description: Velvet-black distillate of the Great Putrefaction that drinks stray light and strips matter to pure potential.

ingredients.name: Elixir Vitae
ingredients.description: Opalescent rose-and-emerald draught of universal renewal that mends decay and harmonizes opposing elements.

ingredients.name: Philosopher's Stone
ingredients.description: The Magnum Opus incarnate: a self-luminous crimson-gold hyper-crystal uniting Nigredo, Albedo, Citrinitas, and Rubedo.

recipes.lore: Boiling aqua erupts into pressurized white vapor.
Dry soil drinks spring water to form rich malleable mire.
Fierce caloric waves liquefy solid metal into a glowing stream.
Sudden extreme temperature contrast unleashes a shattering shockwave.
Galvanic arcs ionize pure aqua into crackling electrolyte.
Twin flames intensify into pure radiant thermal energy.
Oxygen feeds combustion into a roaring blast of heat.
Biting high-altitude winds chill water droplets into glacial ice.
Colliding storm-vapors build static charge until lightning leaps forth.
Compacted strata fuse under weight into solid bedrock.
Subterranean flame melts terra into incandescent magma.
Quenched magma hisses violently and hardens into basalt.
Baked mire hardens into dry sun-cracked rock.
Sustained furnace heat returns solid rock to molten magma.
Hot vapor condenses against glacial ice into pure liquid water.
Relentless wind scours bedrock into golden silica grains.
Thermal fracture shatters solid boulders into fine sand.
Silica grit and wet mire knead together into smooth potter's clay.
Refined alluvial earth settles into dense kaolin clay.
Volcanic fumaroles deposit bright yellow brimstone crystals.
Smelting stone in direct flame sweats beads of crude metal from ore.
Deep magmatic veins concentrate metallic ore blooms.
Mineral-laden vapor evaporates to leave cubic halite crystals.
Briny coastal sand yields sparkling white salt upon leaching.
Slow ordered cooling coaxing silica into hexagonal rock crystal.
Piezoelectric discharge aligns mineral silica into clear quartz.
Instant cryogenic quenching freezes magma into razor-sharp black glass.
Shock-cooled volcanic flow vitrifies into mirror-dark obsidian.
Burning brimstone flux lowers rock's melting point into magma.
Shattered crystal prisms crumble into sparkling silica sand.
Airborne spores take root across damp mire as emerald moss.
River-washed stone sprouts a velvety coat of living moss.
Rooted moss matures in rich soil into fragrant silverleaf herbs.
Hydrated bryophytes unfurl into medicinal apothecary leaves.
Warm caloric radiance coaxes silverleaf buds into golden sunpetals.
Solar pollen invigorates humble moss into lush herbal shoots.
Glacial rime crystallizes living foliage into an immortal frostbloom.
Frozen tundra moss blossoms into delicate blue ice-lilies.
Deep boggy humus nurtures bioluminescent cavern mycelium.
Bio-galvanic current awakens glowing cyan fungal caps.
Sulfurous fumes twist gentle herbs into venomous purple nightshade.
Alkaline ash and cavern spores mutate into potent shadow berries.
Molded terracotta and living roots intertwine into sentient mandragora.
Alkaloid berries buried in fertile mire sprout a knotted mandrake root.
Solar nectar sealed in clay hardens into translucent golden amber.
Steam-distilled botanical sap condenses into fragrant amber teardrops.
Dry moss calcines in seconds into pale alkaline potash.
Apothecary leaves burn down to purified white mineral ash.
Earthy carbon tempers crude bloom into magnetic forged iron.
Quenching white-hot metal in water tempers resilient dark iron.
Oxidized smelting yields warm salmon-red Venusian copper.
Current-drawn refining isolates pure conductive copper.
Cold lunar cupellation refines metal into mirror-bright silver.
Prismatic resonance purifies base iron toward noble lunar sheen.
Heavy earthy dross settles into dense Saturnine lead.
Slag-heavy smelting yields ponderous dull-grey lead.
Fluid metallic principle awakens as shimmering liquid mercury.
Noble silver dissolved in liquid heat flows as living quicksilver.
Galvanic electrolysis liberates fluid mercury from heavy lead.
Red copper alloyed in molten metal casts sonorous golden bronze.
Forged bimetallic fusion yields corrosion-proof alchemical bronze.
Classical Paracelsian union of Mercury and Brimstone births Solar Gold!
Lunar silver steeped in concentrated solar essence ripens into pure Gold!
Red-hot forged iron surrenders its shape back into liquid metal.
Heated copper coils melt into a glowing orange pool.
Low-melting Saturnine lead liquefies swiftly over the burner.
Silica grains fuse into crystal-clear borosilicate laboratory glass.
Roaring flame vitrifies golden sand into transparent glass.
Crushed quartz fluxed on molten tin forms flawless optical glass.
Kiln-fired kaolin vitrifies into heatproof white porcelain.
Terracotta clay hardens in open flame into refractory ceramic.
Electrolyzed brimstone fumes condense into caustic green Oil of Vitriol.
Hot sulfurous vapor condenses in glass coils as biting Vitriol Acid.
Brimstone ground with alkaline potash forms volatile black powder.
Crystalline saltpeter and sulfur blend into deflagrating powder.
Ignited black powder detonates in a concussive blast wave!
Liquid mercury drinks red copper into a pliable metallic amalgam.
Silver dissolves effortlessly in mercury to form mirror amalgam.
Forced galvanic wetting binds reluctant iron with quicksilver.
Vitriol and halite distill into fuming orange-gold Royal Water!
Hyper-ionized acid turns amber-red with the power to dissolve gold.
Caustic vitriol dissolves crude metal, precipitating mineral salt.
Acid and alkaline ash neutralize in fizzing effervescence to yield salt.
Rubbed golden Elektron resin crackles with ancient static sparks!
High-voltage supercooling locks water into an Absolute Zero lattice!
High-frequency crystal resonance sublimates energy into Luminous Aether!
Sealed Leyden glow distills weightless quintessence inside pure glass.
Superheated lightning strips electrons away into blazing violet Plasma!
Arc-furnace discharge ignites a self-contained magnetic plasma orb.
Combustion inside ionized aqua flashes into fourth-state plasma.
Alpine frost-essence and volcanic glass fuse into an Absolute Zero Shard!
Quintessential cold perfects glacial ice into an unmelting sapphire obelisk.
Living solar petals ignited by star-plasma awaken an immortal Phoenix Cinder!
Auric detonation leaves behind a self-renewing crimson-gold ember.
Botanical sunlight survives magmatic fire by rebirthing as a Phoenix Cinder.
Volcanic black glass and midnight poison distill into Abyssal Nigredo!
Saturnine heaviness dissolved in quintessence yields pure Nigredo darkness.
Auric incorruptibility bound to vital mandragora blooms into Elixir Vitae!
Quintessence infused with root-of-life distills the panacea of immortality.
Nigredo and Rubedo unite! Darkness and Immortal Life crystallize into the Philosopher's Stone!
Royal Water and Immortal Flame Fuse into the supreme crimson Philosopher's Stone!
True Chrysopoeia! A grain of the Stone transmutes base Saturnine Lead into pure Solar Gold!
Transmutative projection elevates martial Iron into gleaming Lunar Silver!
Dissolving incorruptible Gold in Royal Water liberates trapped Luminous Aether!
Tri-elemental tempest inside the manifold generates pure storm lightning!
Balanced ternary sediment blend yields studio-grade refractory clay.
True historical ternary formula! Brimstone, potash, and saltpeter unite into potent Black Powder.
Direct furnace smelting casts high-resonance Alchemical Bronze in one stage.
Potash flux lowers silica's fusion point to blow crystal-clear glass.
The Sacred Tria Prima! Spirit, Soul, and Body harmonize directly into Solar Gold!
Botanical triad energized by galvanic aqua brews radiant Elixir Vitae!
Triple cryogenic resonance grows a flawless Absolute Zero Shard!
Shattered black glass and calcined ash collapse into Abyssal Nigredo!
Solar gold, blossom, and flame ignite an eternal Phoenix Cinder!
Heated distillation of vitriol and halite yields potent fuming Aqua Regia.
Piezoelectric arc through superheated vapor ignites Contained Plasma!
Bioluminescent light trapped in amber and focused through quartz distills Aether!
Royal electrum-mercury paste shimmers with catalytic conductivity.
Great Spagyric Remedy: poison transmuted by vital root and amber into Panacea!
Coincidentia Oppositorum! Immortal Fire and Absolute Frost bound in Mercury forge the Philosopher's Stone!

upgrades.name: Athanor Arcane Burner
upgrades.description: Upgrades the under-crucible furnace from an amber spirit lamp to a cobalt-violet Athanor jet, accelerating reaction speed and boosting RP from thermal & metallic syntheses.
tiers: Reaction time 0.85s | +15% RP on Thermal & Metallic reactions | Cobalt flame
Reaction time 0.55s | +30% RP on Thermal & Metallic reactions | Twin brass jets
Reaction time 0.35s | +50% RP on ALL reactions | Incandescent violet Athanor

upgrades.name: Tri-Crucible Mixing Manifold
upgrades.description: Installs a precision third brass reagent pedestal and copper return conduit, unlocking 3-ingredient multi-stage syntheses and one-click reaction chaining.
tiers: Unlocks 3rd Catalyst Pedestal for 3-ingredient multi-stage recipes
Unlocks Chain-Feed (send result directly into Slot 1) +20% 3-slot RP
Master Manifold: +45% RP on multi-stage recipes & dual-output resonance

upgrades.name: Gyroscopic Reaction Stabilizers
upgrades.short_effect: Salvages RP on fizzles & adds Timed bonus
upgrades.description: Mounts spinning quartz-and-brass containment rings around the cauldron, harvesting residual energy from failed experiments and stabilizing volatile timed trials.
tiers: Failed mixes salvage +3 RP instead of 0 | Spinning inner brass ring
Failed mixes salvage +6 RP & tell if Slot 1 has undiscovered pairs
Failed mixes salvage +10 RP & grant +5s time bonus per Timed Trial brew

upgrades.name: Apothecary Storage Racks
upgrades.short_effect: Expands Quick-Pin Tray & Recipe Replay History
upgrades.description: Expands carved walnut shelves and crystal jars, enlarging your Workbench Quick-Pin Favorites bar and Recent Synthesis Replay log.
tiers: Unlocks 8 Quick-Pin Favorite slots & 5 Recent Synthesis replay slots
Unlocks 12 Quick-Pin Favorite slots & 8 Recent Synthesis replay slots
Unlocks 16 Quick-Pin Favorite slots & 12 Recent Synthesis replay slots

upgrades.name: Clockwork Auto-Experimenter
upgrades.description: Activates a spring-driven brass automaton arm beside the cauldron that methodically tests untried combinations of your discovered substances while toggled ON.
tiers: Unlocks Auto-Experiment toggle (tests an untried pair every 5.0s)
Precision escapement: tests an untried pair or trio every 2.8s
Grand Automaton: tests every 1.4s & prioritizes valid new discoveries

upgrades.name: Hermetic Spectroscope
upgrades.short_effect: Reveals Journal clues & boosts Discovery RP
upgrades.description: Equips the Research Board with a dispersion prism spectroscope that decodes partial formulas in the Encyclopedia and amplifies Research Point insights.
tiers: Reveals Result Category & Reaction Type of undiscovered Journal recipes | +15% Discovery RP
Reveals 1st Ingredient of non-hidden undiscovered recipes | +25% Discovery RP
Decodes 1st Ingredient even on Hidden Mysteries | +40% Discovery RP

upgrades.name: Rare Resonance Detector
upgrades.description: Ignites a crystalline resonance lantern on your desk that pulses when a slotted reagent has undiscovered reactions, and can scan for valid partner hints.
tiers: Desk Lantern glows when Slot 1 has undiscovered recipes | Scan Hint (15s cooldown)
Distinguishes Rare/Hidden resonance in Violet-Gold | Scan Hint (6s cooldown)
Instant Partner Highlight badge in inventory + Scan slots a valid pair (2s cooldown)

challenges.title: Apprentice Glassblower
challenges.description: Every true laboratory requires acid-proof vessels. Synthesize Alchemical Glass from mineral silica and intense thermal energy.

challenges.title: Distillation of Vitriol
challenges.description: Synthesize corrosive green Vitriol Acid by uniting volcanic Brimstone Sulfur with pressurized vapor or ionized water.

challenges.title: Metallurgist's Fourfold Chain
challenges.description: Master the complete metallurgical chain: discover Lava, smelt Crude Metal, liquefy Molten Metal, and alloy Alchemical Bronze.

challenges.title: Royal Dissolution Protocol
challenges.description: Complete the multi-stage synthetic pathway culminating in fuming orange-gold Aqua Regia.

challenges.title: Riddle of Ancient Elektron
challenges.description: Hidden Formula Puzzle: 'Rub golden tears of ancient sunlit trees against the rushing wind to wake the sleeping storm-spark.'

challenges.title: Riddle of the Black Sun
challenges.description: Hidden Formula Puzzle: 'When razor-sharp volcanic midnight drinks the venomous belladonna berry, Abyssal Nigredo awakens.'

challenges.title: Paracelsian Secret of Sol
challenges.description: Hidden Formula Puzzle: 'Wed the silver fluid Spirit to the yellow volcanic Soul to birth incorruptible Solar Gold.'

challenges.title: Triad of the Sages
challenges.description: Hidden 3-Slot Puzzle: 'Unite Spirit (Quicksilver), Soul (Sulfur), and Body (Salt) simultaneously in the Tri-Crucible Manifold.'

challenges.title: Timed Trial: Crucible Blitz
challenges.description: Activate this Timed Trial and successfully execute 5 valid alchemical reactions within 60 seconds!

challenges.title: Timed Trial: Fire & Frost
challenges.description: Activate this Timed Trial and synthesize Steam, Thermal Shock, and Obsidian within 75 seconds!

challenges.title: Timed Trial: Grand Synthesis
challenges.description: Activate this Timed Trial and brew Alchemical Glass, Vitriol Acid, Solar Gold, and Luminous Aether before the 90s hourglass runs dry!

challenges.title: Imperial Herbarium
challenges.description: Research Objective: Cultivate and discover all 8 botanical substances in the Plants category.

challenges.title: Seven Planetary Metals & Beyond
challenges.description: Research Objective: Smelt, refine, and transmute all 9 substances in the Metals category.

challenges.title: Phenomenology of Chaos
challenges.description: Research Objective: Witness all 10 distinct physical reaction phenomena (Bubbling, Smoke, Sparks, Explosion, Crystallization, Freezing, Melting, Electrical, Liquid Mixing, Color Transition).

challenges.title: Cabinet of Quintessence
challenges.description: Research Objective: Discover all 7 Rare & Mythic substances at the pinnacle of the encyclopedia.

challenges.title: The Magnum Opus
challenges.description: Synthesize the legendary Philosopher's Stone - the ultimate triumph of Alchemy Chaos.

achievements.title: First Transmutation
achievements.desc: Complete your very first successful alchemical synthesis.

achievements.title: Complete Encyclopedia
achievements.desc: Discover all 50 unique substances in Alchemy Chaos!

achievements.title: Grand Sanctum Apparatus
achievements.desc: Upgrade any piece of laboratory equipment to Level 3 (MAX).
